project_type: Standalone AWS DVA-C03 'Testing and Deployment' demo (demo/session4-coffee-ship). This task rewrites the container path into a REAL app: a boto3 Python 3.12 http.server app on ECS/Fargate behind an ALB behind CloudFront, built/deployed by a real CodePipeline (S3 source -> EventBridge -> CodeBuild docker build/push to ECR -> EcsDeployAction rolling deploys + manual approval). Data plane: DynamoDB coffee-ship-orders + SSM loyalty parameter. Also touches infra (one IAM grant), the React SPA, the architecture diagram, and docs.
language: Python 3.12 (container app, now boto3 not stdlib-only) + JavaScript/JSX (React 18 + Vite 5 SPA) + TypeScript (CDK v2 infra) + Python (diagram generator) + Markdown docs.
build_system: SPA: Vite 5 via npm (built inside the multi-stage Docker image, node:20-alpine stage). Container image: docker build with context 'container/' (python:3.12-slim runtime stage now runs pip install -r requirements.txt). Infra: CDK v2 aws-cdk-lib 2.160.0 in demo/session4-coffee-ship/infra via npx (ts-node app, bin/coffee-ship.ts).

(1) cd .../container/frontend && npm install && npm run build -> dist/index.html + dist/assets/* exist. (2) python3 -m py_compile .../container/app.py exits 0 (boto3 import must be guarded so this works even without boto3). (3) cd .../container && python3 -m pytest -q test_app.py (or python3 test_app.py) -> status_for RECEIVED(<10s)/BREWING(10-25s)/READY(>=25s) all pass. (4) Runtime smoke: STATIC_DIR=.../container/frontend/dist PORT=8080 python3 .../container/app.py & then curl: GET / -> text/html 200; GET /health -> {"status":"ok","version":"v3-realapp"} 200 (MUST be 200 even with no AWS creds / DynamoDB unreachable); GET /architecture.svg -> image/svg+xml 200; GET /nope.js -> 404; GET /spa/route -> text/html 200; server must NOT crash. Kill it after. (5) cd .../ && docker build -t coffee-ship:realapp-test container/ succeeds (exercises the new pip install boto3); docker image rm coffee-ship:realapp-test after. key_patterns: API is SAME-ORIGIN unauthenticated: the SPA calls relative paths /order, /orders, /order/{id}, /health - no base URL, no CORS. ALB health check targets GET / expecting 200; GET / returns the SPA index.html (text/html 200), so it stays green. The ECS container name is the ApplicationLoadBalancedFargateService default 'web'. ALB SG is locked via addPropertyOverride('SecurityGroupIngress', ...) to SourcePrefixListId of the CloudFront origin-facing prefix list (pl-31a34658, a CfnParameter) - NO 0.0.0.0/0. The VPC is imported via ec2.Vpc.fromVpcAttributes + Fn.importValue (VpcId, VpcCidrBlock, PublicSubnetOne/Two/Three) - NO VPC is created. Pipeline: S3 SourceAction trigger NONE + explicit events.Rule on S3 'Object Created' for source.zip. The task role already has ordersTable.grantReadWriteData + ordersQueue.grantConsumeMessages; it LACKS ssm:GetParameter on the loyalty param. compute: points = floor(total) * loyalty_rate (rate from SSM /coffee-ship/loyalty/points-per-dollar, default 10). PORT default 8080. status_for is a PURE function of (created_at, now): RECEIVED <10s, BREWING 10-25s, READY >=25s. Diagram generator pattern: session3 build_diagram.py embeds icons base64 - reuse the zones/bezier/legend approach but embed *_64.svg as data:image/svg+xml;base64.
